metadata.journal_name: Stanford Journal of Law, Business & Finance

navigation.notes: Identical law.stanford.edu WordPress theme to STLR and SJCRCL: article[itemtype='https://schema.org/ScholarlyArticle'] rows with a[itemprop='url workExample'] pointing at /wp-content/uploads/*.pdf. FacetWP pager renders server-side for ?_paged=N; page 10+ returns 0 articles. Publication scope: every row stamps li.ptp-publisher = 'Stanford Journal of Law, Business & Finance' (verified on pages 1, 2, 8, 9). Supersedes the earlier unvalidated article.loop-item.pt-publication + a[href$='.pdf'] selectors, which were never live-checked (see data/reference/journal_recon/stanford_journal_of_law_business_finance.json). robots.txt allows the archive path but sets Crawl-delay: 600 - run with a large MIN_DELAY. Requires a browser-like User-Agent. Range carries headroom above the 9 pages observed 2026-08-28; pages past the end return HTTP 200 with zero articles and cost nothing. Alternatively drop the ?_paged=[..] range entirely and StanfordSTLRAdapter will walk ?_paged=N itself until an empty page.
